component_guidelines.buttons: Primary button in #FACC15 with black text (#111827), font-semibold, rounded-lg, hover:bg-yellow-400 shadow-sm transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-yellow-400 focus:ring-offset-2
component_guidelines.badges: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded rectangular badges with low-opacity background and solid text matching the status
component_guidelines.modals: Shadcn Dialog wrapped with clean backdrop-blur-sm, white card body, explicit data-testid, and job execution logs viewer
component_guidelines.toasts: Sonner toast system styled with custom yellow accents and icon state indicators
component_guidelines.testing: All key interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='submit-job-button', data-testid='login-form-submit-button', data-testid='worker-concurrency-slider')

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the split-screen login page features a vibrant, animated task processing visualization on the left with QueueFlow branding and the abstract yellow-dark tech background image, and a slick, high-contrast form on the right.
Implement real-time job queue polling every 2.5s with a subtle visual pulse indicator in the header bar.
Make sure user and admin views both provide quick job submission forms (Image Resize, Send Email, Data Export, PDF Generation) with priority selectors (High, Medium, Low).
In Admin Dashboard, render the live statistics cards, Recent Activity audit log feed, job filtering table, search input, worker concurrency slider (1-20), and user management table.
Provide Kanban view and List view toggles for the Job Board with clear visual status columns.
Apply data-testid to every button, input, tab, card, and modal trigger for reliable automation tests.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always specify explicit transitions for interactive properties like background-color, border-color, shadow, transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (no text-align: center on root container).
Always use modern button styles with pill/rounded shapes, micro-interactions, and high contrast active/hover states.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Lucide or Phosphor icons instead.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
